name: quoted_primary_key
description: A quoted PRIMARY KEY column name (inline, and via the pg_dump ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT form) must still match its column and apply NOT NULL -- comparing the constraint's quoted expr.to_string() against the unquoted registered name never matched
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE t ("Id" integer, note text, PRIMARY KEY ("Id"))
CREATE TABLE t2 ("UserId" integer, note text)
ALTER TABLE t2 ADD CONSTRAINT t2_pkey PRIMARY KEY ("UserId")
